svg.text: Half of America's remaining landfill room belongs to two companies
a municipality negotiating a disposal contract
whether you are negotiating in a competitive market or
a third owner reaches a double-digit share of
the tail, as its own study
A county negotiating disposal is negotiating with one of two firms in much of the country, and its alternative is capacity it does not own and cannot build quickly.
The 30 multi-site owners hold 67% of the room; the 510 single-site owners hold 33% of it, a median 3.3M tons each.
Owner names are normalised first. Raw, the register reports 304 ownership changes between its two editions; 250 are one firm renaming itself to WM, and regional suffixes split a fourth.
